column3: Requests that started at or before the journal loss horizon (+16 ms slack) are left out and counted, with BootUI's LEFT_OUT_BEFORE_LOSS wording, in the check reason and the report limitations (RuntimeInsightsService.visibleEntries, leftOutBeforeLoss, v2.3.0; EvidenceRing.lost). Moved at v2.3.0 on eviction, discard and an event larger than the byte bound (EvidenceRing.add l.92-93); NOT moved for a paused journal or an unconfigured source, because v2.3.0 RuntimeJournal.offer returns false there without ring.lost (those lost() calls arrive after 2.3.0). Not ported: aiCallsLeftOut (an AI event carries its end time only, so beforeLoss cannot be evaluated on its start; an AI event of a left-out request is reported as 'joined no retained request') and errorLogsLeftOut (needs lostRequestEndMillis and lostRequestThreads, which the journal does not keep); executions other than http; the clear-time evictedRequestTraces. Each needs its own producer fact.
